commands.name: list-packages
commands.summary: List CTAN packages whose name starts with a given letter (package slug and URL)

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get a package's detail page: title and catalogue entry table (version, license, home page, etc.)

commands.name: get-package-history
commands.summary: Get a package's release timeline as [year, month, version] tuples

commands.name: get-package-rating
commands.summary: Get a package's rating breakdown: the number of votes for each star level

commands.name: list-package-comments
commands.summary: List user comments on a package (commenter, profile link, date), paginated

commands.name: list-topics
commands.summary: List all topics with slug, URL and a tooltip containing the description and package count

commands.name: list-topics-by-count
commands.summary: List topics ranked by number of packages

commands.name: list-topic-packages
commands.summary: List the packages in a topic

commands.name: list-top-contributors
commands.summary: List top contributors with their package counts

commands.name: list-contributors
commands.summary: List contributors whose surname starts with a given letter

commands.name: get-contributor
commands.summary: List the packages maintained by a contributor

commands.name: list-announcements
commands.summary: List the latest CTAN-ann announcements (package uploads and updates)

commands.name: get-announcement
commands.summary: Get the full text of an announcement and the package it concerns

commands.name: list-package-announcements
commands.summary: List all announcements for one package

commands.name: browse-archive
commands.summary: List subdirectories and files (size, date, download URL) in a CTAN archive directory

commands.name: list-licenses
commands.summary: List the license keys used in the TeX Catalogue (free and non-free)

commands.name: get-license
commands.summary: Get a license's name, text and reference link

commands.name: get-license-stats
commands.summary: Get how many packages use a license, out of the total package count

commands.name: get-upload-stats
commands.summary: Get monthly CTAN upload counts as [year, month, count] tuples

commands.name: get-random-package
commands.summary: Get a random featured package (key, name, caption, description)

dropped.name: get-archive-directory
dropped.reason: The path param's slashes get URL-encoded to %2F, so the server returns 404. The template cannot hold a path of variable depth. browse-archive already lists directory contents and get-package returns the catalogue entry.
